entities.summary: Noel Portal Pedregosa is a Filipino prelate of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Malaybalay, appointed by Pope Francis on June 29, 2021. He will follow the steps of Jose Cabantan after he was made the Archbishop of Cagayan de Oro in August 2020. Pedregosa took possession of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Malaybalay on September 14, 2021.
